    @CLayout(aligned = 8, packed = 1)
  struct Packed
    field value: Int8
    field flag: Boolean

    Data(Packed)
    Text(String)
    Empty
  struct Wrapper
    field choice: Choice
  struct Unused
    field ignored: ULong
